title: Parambarai
desc: Paramasivan has a rocky relationship with his father following the tragic murder of his mother. To make matters more complicated, he falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless landlord.

title: Chidambarathil Oru Appasamy
desc: A school teacher leads a carefree life without any goal. However, a pilgrimage to Sabarimala transforms his life and the lives of his loved ones forever.

title: Sakthi Parasakthi
desc: Shanthi is subjugated to cruel harassment from her mother-in-law, who never wanted her as her son's bride. Sakthi, Shanthi's best friend, decides to avenge the injustice done to her friend.

title: Enn Uyir Nanba
desc: An honest reporter is delighted to secure a job at a local news agency. However, his simple life takes an unexpected turn after he falls in love with the daughter of the agency's director.

title: Jaisurya
desc: Surya, a fraudster, comes across an honest district collector, Jai, who is his lookalike. Things change when circumstances make him step into Jai's shoes.
